about: Plain-language names and one-line descriptions for every rule in rules/biasclear-rules.json. Every page of the site takes a move's name from here: the checker, its readout and list, the tier lists and the Field Guide. The site build fails if a rule in the pack is missing here, or if this file names a rule the pack does not have. Each description says what the wording does, not what the writer means.

CONSENSUS_AS_EVIDENCE.name: Consensus as proof
CONSENSUS_AS_EVIDENCE.short: Treats agreement as if it were evidence.

CLAIM_WITHOUT_CITATION.name: Unsourced authority
CLAIM_WITHOUT_CITATION.short: Cites studies or experts without saying which.

DISSENT_DISMISSAL.name: Dissent dismissed
DISSENT_DISMISSAL.short: Labels the doubters instead of answering them.

FALSE_BINARY.name: False binary
FALSE_BINARY.short: Presents two options as the only ones.

FEAR_URGENCY.name: Fear + urgency
FEAR_URGENCY.short: Raises the stakes and shortens the clock.

EMOTIONAL_SUBSTITUTION.name: Feeling for evidence
EMOTIONAL_SUBSTITUTION.short: Puts a feeling where a reason should be.

CREDENTIAL_AS_PREMISE.name: Credential as proof
CREDENTIAL_AS_PREMISE.short: Offers a title, school, award or years of experience as the reason to believe.

INSTITUTIONAL_POSITION_AS_SETTLED.name: Finding with no reasons
INSTITUTIONAL_POSITION_AS_SETTLED.short: Says a body has concluded something, and gives no reason or source.

NEUTRALITY_CLAIM.name: Neutrality claimed
NEUTRALITY_CLAIM.short: Calls its own view neutral or objective instead of showing the evidence.

BUREAUCRATIC_OBSCURITY.name: Fog language
BUREAUCRATIC_OBSCURITY.short: Wraps the point in process language.

INEVITABILITY_FRAME.name: Inevitability
INEVITABILITY_FRAME.short: Presents the outcome as already decided.

APPEAL_TO_TRADITION.name: Appeal to tradition
APPEAL_TO_TRADITION.short: Treats how it has always been done as a reason.

FALSE_EQUIVALENCE.name: False equivalence
FALSE_EQUIVALENCE.short: Sets two positions side by side as equally supported.

MORAL_HIGH_GROUND.name: Moral high ground
MORAL_HIGH_GROUND.short: Frames one side as simply the decent one.

SOFT_CONSENSUS.name: Soft consensus
SOFT_CONSENSUS.short: Implies a growing agreement without saying whose.

COMPETENCE_DISMISSAL.name: Competence dismissed
COMPETENCE_DISMISSAL.short: Questions the critic’s grasp instead of the claim.

VAGUE_INSTITUTIONAL_APPEAL.name: Vague authority
VAGUE_INSTITUTIONAL_APPEAL.short: Leans on bodies or standards it does not name.

ASPIRATIONAL_DEFLECTION.name: Aspirational deflection
ASPIRATIONAL_DEFLECTION.short: Answers a concern with a statement of intent.

DISMISSAL_BY_REFRAMING.name: Dismissal by reframing
DISMISSAL_BY_REFRAMING.short: Restates a position so it is easier to wave off.

CAUSAL_TOTALIZATION.name: Single cause
CAUSAL_TOTALIZATION.short: Credits one force with wrecking everything.

MONOCAUSAL_BLAME.name: One culprit
MONOCAUSAL_BLAME.short: Makes one cause the reason for all of it.

TOTALIZING_HARM_LANGUAGE.name: Total harm
TOTALIZING_HARM_LANGUAGE.short: Describes harm as total and final.

LEGAL_SETTLED_DISMISSAL.name: Settled law
LEGAL_SETTLED_DISMISSAL.short: Calls the question settled instead of answering it.

LEGAL_MERIT_DISMISSAL.name: Merit waved off
LEGAL_MERIT_DISMISSAL.short: Calls an argument frivolous or meritless without answering it.

LEGAL_WEIGHT_STACKING.name: Weight of authority
LEGAL_WEIGHT_STACKING.short: Counts the authorities instead of giving their reasons.

LEGAL_SANCTIONS_THREAT.name: Sanctions raised
LEGAL_SANCTIONS_THREAT.short: Raises sanctions or a referral in answer to an argument.

LEGAL_PROCEDURAL_GATEKEEPING.name: Procedural bar
LEGAL_PROCEDURAL_GATEKEEPING.short: Answers with a procedural bar instead of the substance.

LEGAL_STRAW_MAN.name: Position made absolute
LEGAL_STRAW_MAN.short: Restates the other side in all-or-nothing terms.

MEDIA_EDITORIAL_AS_NEWS.name: Loaded descriptor
MEDIA_EDITORIAL_AS_NEWS.short: Puts a judging adjective into a news description.

MEDIA_ANONYMOUS_ATTRIBUTION.name: Faceless source
MEDIA_ANONYMOUS_ATTRIBUTION.short: Credits a claim to sources no reader can check.

MEDIA_WEASEL_QUANTIFIERS.name: Vague crowd
MEDIA_WEASEL_QUANTIFIERS.short: Says many or some believe it, without saying who.

MEDIA_FALSE_BALANCE.name: False balance
MEDIA_FALSE_BALANCE.short: Sets what some say against what most experts say, as an even debate.

MEDIA_EMOTIONAL_LEAD.name: Emotional lead
MEDIA_EMOTIONAL_LEAD.short: Opens with charged words before the facts.

MEDIA_BURIED_QUALIFIER.name: Late qualifier
MEDIA_BURIED_QUALIFIER.short: Puts the denial or correction far down the text.

MEDIA_SELECTIVE_QUOTATION.name: Scare quotes
MEDIA_SELECTIVE_QUOTATION.short: Puts quotation marks around a word to cast doubt on it.

MEDIA_ASYMMETRIC_ATTRIBUTION.name: Loaded quote verbs
MEDIA_ASYMMETRIC_ATTRIBUTION.short: Uses verbs like claimed or insisted where said would do.

MEDIA_SPECULATIVE_FRAMING.name: Guess as likely
MEDIA_SPECULATIVE_FRAMING.short: Presents a possible outcome as the expected one.

FIN_SURVIVORSHIP_BIAS.name: Counting only winners
FIN_SURVIVORSHIP_BIAS.short: Draws a lesson from the winners alone.

FIN_ANCHORING.name: Chosen reference point
FIN_ANCHORING.short: Measures a price against a chosen high or low.

FIN_CHERRY_PICKED_TIMEFRAME.name: Chosen timeframe
FIN_CHERRY_PICKED_TIMEFRAME.short: Measures a result from one start date.

FIN_PROJECTION_AS_FACT.name: Forecast as fact
FIN_PROJECTION_AS_FACT.short: States a forecast as a certainty.

FIN_RECENCY_EXTRAPOLATION.name: Streak extended
FIN_RECENCY_EXTRAPOLATION.short: Extends a recent run into the future.
